text:
{
  "pros": [
    "Open-source nature and strong security focus.",
    "Generous free tier for individuals and affordable premium plans.",
    "Wide cross-platform availability (browser extensions, desktop, mobile).",
    "Ability to self-host the server for ultimate control.",
    "Easy and flexible creation of diverse item types (logins, notes, cards, SSH keys).",
    "Robust search and filtering capabilities for vault items."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "User interface (UI) and user experience (UX) can feel less polished than competitors.",
    "Complexity and separation between personal vault and organization management/admin console.",
    "Limited free tier for teams (e.g., 2 users, 2 collections).",
    "Custom fields are not prominently displayed or easily accessible during initial item creation.",
    "Steeper learning curve for advanced features like organization setup and sharing.",
    "Some advanced features found in premium competitors might be missing or less intuitive."
  ],
  "overall_rating": "4.5"
}

pros: Open-source nature and strong security focus.
Generous free tier for individuals and affordable premium plans.
Wide cross-platform availability (browser extensions, desktop, mobile).
Ability to self-host the server for ultimate control.
Easy and flexible creation of diverse item types (logins, notes, cards, SSH keys).
Robust search and filtering capabilities for vault items.
cons: User interface (UI) and user experience (UX) can feel less polished than competitors.
Complexity and separation between personal vault and organization management/admin console.
Limited free tier for teams (e.g., 2 users, 2 collections).
Custom fields are not prominently displayed or easily accessible during initial item creation.
Steeper learning curve for advanced features like organization setup and sharing.
Some advanced features found in premium competitors might be missing or less intuitive.
